-- ── Strings (GlobalStrings.lua, verbatim; %% escapes as shipped) ───────────────────────── local DEATH_RELEASE_TIMER = "%d %s until release" local DEATH_RELEASE_NOTIMER = "You have died. Release to the nearest graveyard?" local DEATH_RELEASE = "Release Spirit" -- Vestigial on this build, and kept anyway because it is what the reference registers: -- HasSoulstone() returns a Spell.dbc NAME whenever it returns anything, and OnShow stamps -- that over button2 — so the only case this default could render is one that cannot -- happen (DisplayButton2 shows the button on exactly the same call). It is the pre-1.6 -- wording, from before "Self-resurrection spells show their name on the button" (decision -- 1746); GlobalStrings still ships it with the comment "Use your soulstone if you have one". local USE_SOULSTONE = "Reincarnate" local RECOVER_CORPSE_TEXT = "Resurrect now?" local RECOVER_CORPSE_TIMER = "%d %s until resurrection" local RECOVER_CORPSE_INSTANCE_TEXT = "You must enter the instance to recover your corpse" local RESURRECT_REQUEST_TEXT = "%s wants to resurrect you. You will be afflicted with resurrection sickness." local RESURRECT_REQUEST_TIMER = "%s wants to resurrect you and will be able to in %d %s. You will be afflicted with resurrection sickness." local RESURRECT_REQUEST_NO_SICKNESS = "%s wants to resurrect you" local RESURRECT_REQUEST_NO_SICKNESS_TIMER = "%s wants to resurrect you and will be able to in %d %s" local CONFIRM_XP_LOSS = "If you find your corpse, you can resurrect for no penalty. If I resurrect you all of your items will take 25%% durability damage (equipped and inventory) and you will be afflicted by %s of Resurrection Sickness." local CONFIRM_XP_LOSS_AGAIN = "Remember, if you find your corpse there is no penalty. Are you sure you want to incur %s of Resurrection Sickness and have all your items take 25%% durability damage?" local CONFIRM_XP_LOSS_NO_SICKNESS = "If you find your corpse, you can resurrect for no penalty. If I resurrect you all of your items will take 25%% durability damage (equipped and inventory)." local CONFIRM_XP_LOSS_AGAIN_NO_SICKNESS = "Remember, if you find your corpse there is no penalty. Are you sure you want to have all your items take 25% durability damage?" local ACCEPT = "Accept" local DECLINE = "Decline" local CANCEL = "Cancel"
-- ── The corpse-side disposition ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── -- Six of these eight dialogs are about a body on the floor, and every one of them wants -- the same three things from the engine: it must be legal to raise while you are dead -- (`whileDead` — that is the whole point of the arc), it takes precedence over a running -- cinematic, and a logout must not quietly close it out from under you. Stamped on here -- instead of retyped six times; the fields still land on the entry, so an addon reading -- StaticPopupDialogs["DEATH"].whileDead sees exactly what the reference's does. local function register_corpse_dialog(which, entry) entry.whileDead = 1 entry.interruptCinematic = 1 entry.notClosableByLogout = 1 StaticPopupDialogs[which] = entry end
-- How long a resurrect offer stands once it becomes answerable. It is both the engine's -- own countdown (`timeout`) and the value OnShow re-seeds past the recovery delay. local RESURRECT_OFFER_SECONDS = 60
-- ── The release dialog (spec: StaticPopup.lua l.375-414) ───────────────────────────────── -- OnShow seeds `timeleft` from GetReleaseTimeRemaining(), which the engine renders through -- its per-tick DEATH text; −1 means this map has no forced release (an instance), so the -- static wording goes in and nothing counts down. `timeout = 0` because the countdown is -- the SERVER's to enforce — it force-releases at 6:00 (0308 §1) — and there is deliberately -- no hideOnEscape: you cannot dismiss dying. Button2 appears only when the server owes us -- a self-resurrect (PLAYER_SELF_RES_SPELL non-zero); without one a cancel falls through -- to the release. register_corpse_dialog("DEATH", { text = DEATH_RELEASE_TIMER, button1 = DEATH_RELEASE, button2 = USE_SOULSTONE, DisplayButton2 = function() return HasSoulstone() end, OnShow = function() local name = this:GetName() this.timeleft = GetReleaseTimeRemaining() if this.timeleft == -1 then getglobal(name .. "Text"):SetText(DEATH_RELEASE_NOTIMER) end -- The self-res names its own button, out of Spell.dbc: "Use Soulstone" (3026, -- 20758-20761), "Reincarnation" (21169), "Twisting Nether" (23700). local soulstone = HasSoulstone() if soulstone then getglobal(name .. "Button2"):SetText(soulstone) end end, OnAccept = function() RepopMe() end, OnCancel = function(data, reason) -- Only a real click on button2 is an answer. "override" and "timeout" are the -- engine taking the dialog away, and neither is the player choosing anything. if reason ~= "clicked" then return end -- Button2 is the self-resurrect (decision 1746): CMSG_SELF_RES, and the server -- casts whatever PLAYER_SELF_RES_SPELL holds. Re-asked rather than remembered -- from OnShow, exactly as the reference does — the field is the server's and can -- have been spent since the dialog opened. if HasSoulstone() then UseSoulstone() else RepopMe() end end, timeout = 0, cancels = "RECOVER_CORPSE", })
-- ── At the corpse (spec: StaticPopup.lua l.1182-1202) — slice 2's range gate raises these. -- Accept is gated behind the recovery delay and, once taken, the dialog STAYS: reclaiming -- is the server's to confirm, and it does so with the descriptor deltas that stand you up. register_corpse_dialog("RECOVER_CORPSE", { StartDelay = GetCorpseRecoveryDelay, delayText = RECOVER_CORPSE_TIMER, text = RECOVER_CORPSE_TEXT, button1 = ACCEPT, OnAccept = function() RetrieveCorpse() return 1 end, timeout = 0, }) -- Your body is inside a dungeon you are standing outside of: a notice, not an offer, so -- it carries no button at all. register_corpse_dialog("RECOVER_CORPSE_INSTANCE", { text = RECOVER_CORPSE_INSTANCE_TEXT, timeout = 0, })
-- ── Somebody else's offer (spec: StaticPopup.lua l.416-505) ────────────────────────────── -- Three registry keys, one shape: with sickness, without, and without a recovery timer to -- wait out. They differ only in the wording and in whether the offer is delay-gated, so -- they are built rather than written three times. -- -- Refusing an offer (or letting it lapse) has to undo the `cancels = "DEATH"` that raising -- it did — otherwise a declined resurrect leaves you dead with nothing on screen to -- release from. local function restore_release_dialog() if UnitIsDead("player") then StaticPopup_Show("DEATH") end end local function resurrect_offer(offer_text, delay_text) return { text = offer_text, button1 = ACCEPT, button2 = DECLINE, OnAccept = function() AcceptResurrect() end, OnCancel = function() DeclineResurrect() restore_release_dialog() end, -- The countdown. Given a `delay_text` the offer is gated: Accept stays dead and -- that text counts the corpse-recovery cooldown down; without one (the no-timer -- variant) Accept is live at once. Either way the offer lapses a minute after it -- becomes answerable, which is why OnShow re-seeds `timeleft` past the gate -- instead of leaving `timeout`'s minute to start the moment it appears. StartDelay = delay_text and GetCorpseRecoveryDelay or nil, delayText = delay_text, OnShow = function() this.timeleft = GetCorpseRecoveryDelay() + RESURRECT_OFFER_SECONDS end, timeout = RESURRECT_OFFER_SECONDS, cancels = "DEATH", hideOnEscape = 1, } end register_corpse_dialog("RESURRECT", resurrect_offer(RESURRECT_REQUEST_TEXT, RESURRECT_REQUEST_TIMER)) register_corpse_dialog("RESURRECT_NO_SICKNESS", resurrect_offer(RESURRECT_REQUEST_NO_SICKNESS, RESURRECT_REQUEST_NO_SICKNESS_TIMER)) register_corpse_dialog("RESURRECT_NO_TIMER", resurrect_offer(RESURRECT_REQUEST_NO_SICKNESS))
-- ── The spirit healer's price (spec: StaticPopup.lua l.1134-1180) ──────────────────────── -- Both variants ask twice. The first Accept rewrites the dialog to a blunter second ask -- and clears `data`; the truthy return keeps it open. The second Accept — now with no data -- — sends the answer. So `data` is at once the payload and the "which ask is this" flag, -- which is why the driver below hands the no-sickness variant a bare 1. -- -- The second ask is a FUNCTION, not a string, because only one of the two has anything to -- substitute: the no-sickness wording carries a bare "25% durability" that format() would -- read as a conversion and choke on. -- -- Neither offer outlives walking away from the healer, so both poll the distance. local function close_when_out_of_reach(elapsed, dialog) if not CheckSpiritHealerDist() then dialog:Hide() end end local function spirit_healer_confirm(first_ask, second_ask) return { text = first_ask, button1 = ACCEPT, button2 = CANCEL, OnAccept = function(data) if not data then AcceptXPLoss() return end -- `this` is the button the engine clicked; the dialog is its parent. local dialog = this:GetParent() getglobal(dialog:GetName() .. "Text"):SetText(second_ask(data)) dialog.data = nil return 1 end, OnUpdate = close_when_out_of_reach, timeout = 0, exclusive = 1, whileDead = 1, showAlert = 1, hideOnEscape = 1, } end StaticPopupDialogs["XP_LOSS"] = spirit_healer_confirm(CONFIRM_XP_LOSS, function(sickness) return format(CONFIRM_XP_LOSS_AGAIN, sickness) end) StaticPopupDialogs["XP_LOSS_NO_SICKNESS"] = spirit_healer_confirm( CONFIRM_XP_LOSS_NO_SICKNESS, function() return CONFIRM_XP_LOSS_AGAIN_NO_SICKNESS end)
-- ── The driver (spec: UIParent.lua l.237-262 + l.399-436) ─────────────────────────────── -- One switch over the arc's events. The reference spreads these arms through the whole of -- UIParent_OnEvent; ours has a frame of its own (below) and nothing else to share it with. function BenillaDeathDriver_OnEvent() if event == "PLAYER_DEAD" then if not StaticPopup_Visible("DEATH") then CloseAllWindows(1) if GetReleaseTimeRemaining() > 0 or GetReleaseTimeRemaining() == -1 then StaticPopup_Show("DEATH") end end elseif event == "PLAYER_ALIVE" then StaticPopup_Hide("DEATH") StaticPopup_Hide("RESURRECT_NO_SICKNESS") elseif event == "PLAYER_UNGHOST" then StaticPopup_Hide("RESURRECT") StaticPopup_Hide("RESURRECT_NO_SICKNESS") StaticPopup_Hide("RESURRECT_NO_TIMER") elseif event == "RESURRECT_REQUEST" then if ResurrectHasSickness() then StaticPopup_Show("RESURRECT", arg1) elseif ResurrectHasTimer() then StaticPopup_Show("RESURRECT_NO_SICKNESS", arg1) else StaticPopup_Show("RESURRECT_NO_TIMER", arg1) end elseif event == "CONFIRM_XP_LOSS" then -- If the healer would charge resurrection sickness, its duration goes into the -- text; if not there is nothing to quote, and the bare 1 handed over instead is -- only the "this is still the first ask" marker the two-step above reads. local sickness = GetResSicknessDuration() local dialog if sickness then dialog = StaticPopup_Show("XP_LOSS", sickness) else dialog = StaticPopup_Show("XP_LOSS_NO_SICKNESS") end if dialog then dialog.data = sickness or 1 end -- The confirm covers the healer's gossip window (spec: UIParent.lua l.412). local gossip = getglobal("GossipFrame") if gossip and gossip:IsVisible() then HideUIPanel(gossip) end elseif event == "CORPSE_IN_RANGE" then StaticPopup_Show("RECOVER_CORPSE") elseif event == "CORPSE_IN_INSTANCE" then StaticPopup_Show("RECOVER_CORPSE_INSTANCE") elseif event == "CORPSE_OUT_OF_RANGE" then StaticPopup_Hide("RECOVER_CORPSE") StaticPopup_Hide("RECOVER_CORPSE_INSTANCE") StaticPopup_Hide("XP_LOSS") end end

Scripts.OnLoad: self:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_DEAD") self:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_ALIVE") self:RegisterEvent("PLAYER_UNGHOST") self:RegisterEvent("RESURRECT_REQUEST") self:RegisterEvent("CONFIRM_XP_LOSS") self:RegisterEvent("CORPSE_IN_RANGE") self:RegisterEvent("CORPSE_IN_INSTANCE") self:RegisterEvent("CORPSE_OUT_OF_RANGE")
